description: AGSC-00-05: a published item is neither draft nor held back; a listed item is a published item that is not retired. A retired item keeps its page, its per-item copies and its place in the graph exports, and leaves search.json, /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /chunks.jsonl, the skill packs, agsc-counts and the index pages that list items (a type's, a tag's, a cluster's members, the home page and the search page). A draft item is on no published surface at all. Derivation over the minimal fixture with two items added to the cluster agent-patterns: alder (status draft) and birch (status retired), both tagged agents and patterns. The build emits /concepts/birch/, /pages/birch.md and /pages/birch.jsonld and no route for alder; the three graph exports name birch and never alder; each listing surface (carried_by and not_carried_by compare the bytes served at the route with the slug as a string) names neither; and the concepts count of agsc-counts in the discovery document stays 2 (handoff and supervisor), the listed concepts only. A route ending in / is served as its index.html. The build is run with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set and no git history.
